subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files as a `bootstrap-extra-files` context contract, or keep the hook limited to recognized bootstrap filenames?
rationale: This changes deterministic system-prompt context and the effective file-loading contract for hook configuration, which is a product and security-boundary choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
options.body: Allow explicitly configured custom-basename files through the existing workspace realpath and size guards after the linked PR or a replacement is repaired and rebased.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Keep `bootstrap-extra-files` limited to recognized workspace context filenames and close custom-file requests as outside the current contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Leave the request open until maintainers design a more general context-file convention instead of expanding this bundled hook.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Custom Files
recommendation.body: Allow explicitly configured custom-basename files through the existing workspace realpath and size guards after the linked PR or a replacement is repaired and rebased.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook feature and is the best available owner for deciding whether the bootstrap context contract should expand.
